title: SDG 3 and its targets
log: 2026-11-01T14:46:38Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The closest bank point introduces Goal 3 only in general terms and does not teach its specific targets on child and maternal deaths and disease, which the new point is about, so it is narrower in coverage and a new point is the safer match.

draft.title: SDG 3 and its targets
card: Sustainable Development Goal 3 is to ensure healthy lives and promote wellbeing for all, at all ages. It is one of the goals set by United Nations members to be met by 2030.
Some targets name deaths to cut. These include maternal deaths (mothers dying from pregnancy or birth) and deaths of newborns and children under five that could be prevented.
Other targets cover disease. They aim to end epidemics such as HIV, tuberculosis and malaria, and to reduce deaths from non-communicable diseases and from road crashes.
Further targets cover wider wellbeing, such as mental health, harm from drugs and alcohol, access to sexual and reproductive health care, and access to safe, affordable medicines and vaccines.
draft.remember: SDG 3 is healthy lives for all ages, with targets on preventable deaths, disease and wellbeing.

a.q: Which of these is a target under SDG 3?
opts: Reducing maternal deaths and preventable child deaths
Giving every child a free primary school place
Making sure all people have safe drinking water
Ending hunger and improving how food is grown
a.why: SDG 3 includes targets on maternal and child deaths. Schooling, drinking water and hunger are the focus of other goals, not of the health goal itself.
a.clue: Which option is directly about people's health and survival?

b.q: A health department in a country sets a plan to cut deaths from tuberculosis and malaria and to lower road crash deaths. Which goal is it working towards?
b.why: Ending epidemics such as tuberculosis and malaria, and cutting road crash deaths, are both targets under SDG 3. The other goals cover different areas, such as schooling, equality and consumption.
b.clue: Think about which goal covers disease and deaths.

a.best: Reducing maternal deaths and preventable child deaths

check.summary: No problems found. The card matches the SDG 3 targets, and both questions have one clearly right answer that the card supports.
